subject: Proposed two-slot format to secure VP attendance
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo on Nov 24 — VP availability check

Hi Sarah,

Quick update from our side — our VP sponsor (Amit Patel) just had an all-hands shifted into the slot we originally planned. He still wants to join the conversation but only has a 20-minute window the morning before the full technical demo.

To avoid losing his presence (and to keep your engineering team’s time productive), would you be open to a two-slot approach: a 20-minute executive overview (VP + product) followed by a separate ~45-minute technical deep dive for engineers? Proposed benefits:
- VP can cover business fit, metrics, and procurement signals up front
- Engineers get an uninterrupted deep dive later with our solutions engineer
- Minimizes rescheduling risk if Amit’s travel changes again — we can keep the deep dive flexible

Attached: redwood_exec_brief_v2.pdf (short exec slide set).

If that works, I’ll propose two concrete slots that keep your procurement folks in the loop. If you’d rather keep a single 60-minute meeting, we can try to shift our internal calendars, but it will be tight.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

---
Attachment: redwood_exec_brief_v2.pdf (21 pages, exec highlights)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aperturehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aperture Health Procurement <procurement@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 17:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo on Nov 24 — VP availability check

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. We appreciate Amit making time. Our preference is still to have one contiguous session if possible (we like walking the VP into the technical details), but we can be flexible. If Amit can only do 20 minutes, I agree the split makes sense.

A few asks from our side:
1) Can the exec overview be before 11am PT? Our engineering team has calendar conflicts later in the day.
2) Include procurement on the exec brief so they understand the commercial ask (cc’d).
3) Can you send a short agenda for each slot so I can align internal attendees?

If you send candidate times I’ll confirm with Amit and the eng lead (Ben Carlson).

—Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Sr. Director, Digital Platforms, Aperture Health
sarah.nguyen@aperturehealth.com | (415) 555-2198

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Aperture Health Procurement <procurement@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo on Nov 24 — VP availability check

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the quick reply. Proposed concrete plan that respects Amit’s limited window and your engineering cadence:

Option A (preferred):
- Exec brief: Tue, Nov 24, 2026 — 10:00–10:20 PT (20 min) — VP (Amit), Sarah, Procurement, Jordan, Vanessa (product)
  Agenda: 1) Business outcomes + deployment model (5 min) 2) Cost/SLAs & procurement asks (8 min) 3) Next steps / roll-in plan (7 min)
- Technical deep dive: Wed, Nov 25, 2026 — 11:00–11:45 PT (45 min) — Eng leads, Solutions Eng (Marcus), SE demo, detailed Q&A
  Agenda: 1) Architecture & integration (15 min) 2) Latency/cost tradeoffs (10 min) 3) Live walkthrough & eval plan (15 min)

Option B (if you prefer one session):
- Single 60-min: Thu, Nov 26, 10:30–11:30 PT (tight for our VP, may be partially remote)

I attached an updated agenda summary (updated_agenda_aperture.docx). If Option A is okay I’ll issue calendar invites and include Doc links + the Meet link below.

Meet link (exec brief): https://meet.google.com/xyz-pqrs-tuv
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/AP-4721

Next steps: Sarah — confirm Option A for the two slots or tell me which slot you prefer to collapse.

Thanks,
Jordan

Adding a quick ops note — I’ll send the two invites once Sarah confirms. Marcus, please prep a condensed live walkthrough (30 minutes) that we can expand in the deep dive if needed; include the KV-cache/latency slide and one short benchmark. Vanessa — can you join the exec brief to run the product slide?

If anything changes on Amit’s travel we’ll fallback to Option B and attempt a single 60-minute block; I’ll include a calendar note that the deep dive is tentative.

Kimberly Park
